searchTerm.title: Search
searchTerm.description: Free text, e.g. a city, county, tenant name or property kind: Austin, Dollar General, car wash, NNN.

states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter US state codes, e.g. TX, FL, CA. Empty = nationwide.

minCapRate.title: Minimum cap rate (%)
minCapRate.description: e.g. 7 or 6.5. Listings without a stated cap rate are left out when this is set.

includeUnpriced.title: Include unpriced listings
includeUnpriced.description: Listings with no asking price (price on request, auctions without a starting bid). Ignored when a price filter is set.

includeDetails.title: Property details and brokers
includeDetails.description: Open each listing for the property facts (year built, lot size, zoning, NOI, tenancy...), investment highlights and the listing brokers with license and brokerage. Off = search data only, faster.

maxListings.title: Maximum listings
maxListings.description: Stop after this many listings, split evenly across the state and type combinations. Crexi returns up to 1,500 per search; each state/type combination is its own search.
